report.comparability: Tables A, B and C answer three different questions, are not directly comparable, and must not be placed in a single ranking. A (4 folds) is the full pillar set where Hawkes exists; B (2 folds) is RMT/Hamilton where Hawkes cannot exist; C (6 folds) is RMT/Hamilton over the whole labelled period, which overlaps A on four of its six folds

covid_2020.scope: existing stored run window; coverage validation only, not a preregistered performance claim

data_provenance.factors: ten deterministic MD5 symbol buckets of the contemporaneous eligible universe; fixed grouping rule, not sectors or licensed indices
limitations: underlying adjusted EOD2 snapshot is not an as-first-published vintage archive
source universe construction inherited; turnover proxy and survivorship coverage caveats remain
persisted original pillars retain prior research-selection history
data_provenance.market_definition: equal-weight average log return of available point-in-time universe members; research index, not an executable portfolio
data_provenance.return_correction: lag computed before universe filter; only consecutive global sessions admitted; re-entry gaps not mistaken for daily returns
data_provenance.source: existing local SERAPH PostgreSQL; read-only repeatable-read

inference.hamilton: causal diagnostics retained; not eligible for original fusion
